WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
above_mean AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    average_fee_rate,
    average_fee_rate - AVG(average_fee_rate) OVER () AS excess
  FROM pair_averages
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    average_fee_rate,
    excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS scope_rank
  FROM above_mean
  WHERE excess > 0
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  acctscope,
  average_fee_rate,
  excess,
  scope_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE scope_rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, scope_rank;
